rachel: FYI team — quick note about next week's release window and a rollback drill. Please skim and flag blockers.

rachel: TL;DR:
- Release freeze: 2026-03-30 00:00 UTC -> 2026-04-02 06:00 UTC for end-of-quarter stability.
- Rollout drill: 2026-03-29 16:00 UTC. We'll exercise canary rollback for a model-serving change.
- Changelog cutoff: 2026-03-28 18:00 UTC (anything after goes to next week).

ivan: What's in scope for the drill?
michael: Drill will simulate a bad model-proxy config causing increased 5xxs. We'll run canary -> monitor -> force revert to validate playbooks. No database schema changes.

ops-bot: ops-bot: maintenance window scheduled: 2026-03-29T16:00:00Z - 2026-03-29T17:00:00Z  id: mw-2165503210

release-czar: I'll publish the rollback checklist and assign observers. Also prepping the weekly changelog entry and an executive summary for the Friday sync.

oncall: Can we confirm who will be on immediate rollback duty?
rachel: @ivan will execute rollback commands, @michael will validate health gates, on-call will monitor. If any of them are unavailable, @release-czar will step in.

ivan: Rollback script I plan to use:
- `ci/canary/set_percent model-serving 0`
- `kubectl rollout undo deployment/model-serving -n inference`
- `rctl apply --file=configs/model-proxy-prev.yaml`
Keep it ready in the runbook.

michael: Health gates during the drill:
- 5xx increase > 0.15% over 5m -> automatic abort
- p99 latency increase > 20% -> abort
- error budget burn > 30% -> notify SRE
If any gate trips we revert immediately.

rachel: Note on Dedicated tenants: freeze applies to non-critical updates. If a customer needs an urgent fix, we'll handle case-by-case with approvals from product and release-czar.

release-czar: I'll add a line to the weekly changelog: "Planned release freeze for EoQ; rollback drill 2026-03-29 to validate playbooks." Also will send a T-24h reminder and embed the rollback checklist.

ivan: Runbook link: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/rollback-drill-20260329

michael: I'll add a quick smoke test to the canary job for tokenized-stream latency and request success rate.

ops-bot: deploy-bot: canary job prepped: job id dpl-20260329-1600 (queued)

rachel: Thanks. Please keep this thread for live markers during the drill (start, fail-check, revert, postmortem note). If you see anything odd before the window shout here or DM me. :eyes:
